nodes.n: The tour leaves the morning Part Two drops. Six weeks abroad. You read the full contract on Vivaan's channel at the boarding gate, like everyone else in the country.

msgs.t: Tara. Your mother paid Vivaan. Your father showed me. I'm sorry I didn't say it last night.
...I know. Papa's nurse called me at 4 AM.
Thank you for going to see him. Nobody goes to see him.

nodes.n: The other side of the world. Rain. Every press conference is about the contract. Not one question about cricket.

nodes.t: Board's furious. Sponsors are dropping. And there's a TV anchor in the lobby who keeps "accidentally" getting in the lift with you.
Photos already. You, her, a lift. Captain, you are a disaster magnet.

msgs.t: No, don't answer. Clause seven. I have no right to ask.

choice.t: Text: "You're allowed to ask. Clause seven is dead."

nodes.n: Two days later. A knock on your hotel door at midnight. Room service, you think.
Tara Kapoor. Soaked. No makeup. No security. No photographers. She took three flights.

nodes.t: I don't know anything about cricket. But I know what you look like when you're lying, and I know what you look like when you're tired. You look tired.

nodes.cliff: Tara Kapoor crossed the world without telling anyone. Not even Nikhil.
